design.decision: Count the extra trumps before bidding and plan to ruff the side suit that just got shorter.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; opponents meet more trumping and fewer safe side-suit winners.
design.rationale: Trump length is standalone trick-taking value in any build; seed-become-heart (-15.1) concentrated a side suit, so this tests the suit-change shape with the one suit that always helps.
